_what: hype — built from the v11 reel ('$2 BILLION'). Beat-locked cutting, one word far too large. Ours sits OVER the picture; the reference puts it BEHIND the subject, which needs a matte we do not have.

engine.type_engine: typefaces.hype — one word at ~0.3 frame height, overrunning the edges

rules.onsets: cut ends snap to the nearest onset within 90 ms

grade.note: reference: luma 35, saturation 0.37 — mid-dark so the type carries the colour

known_gaps: Type is over the picture, not behind the subject: no matte. Same scale and rhythm, different composite.
